Watch the official trailer for WARHAMMER: 40,000 Skitarii Skulls, a cinematic new reveal from the grim darkness of the far future.

The Imperium rises as the Skitarii march into war, bringing the cold machine faith of the Adeptus Mechanicus to the battlefield. Built for destruction, sworn to the Omnissiah, and unleashed against the enemies of mankind, this new Warhammer 40K cinematic delivers a brutal look at the next chapter of the franchise.

Coming in 2026.

Enjoy advanced 4K Upscaling and HDR-10 mastering across future trailers. Stay tuned for more.
